equities could see a relief bounce soon, but my base case is that most of the coins that led the recent rally will eventually retest their summer lows

those levels are going to be important for how i view the next cycle

if they hold, i could see the bull market starting to pick up again around Q2 2027

if we break below those lows and start making new ones, i think the recovery gets pushed further out

for now, i'm watching how price reacts at those levels before getting more optimistic
